title: Resume.Ai
about: Resume.ai is an AI-powered resume analysis and improvement platform designed to help users build ATS-friendly resumes. It provides instant feedback, highlights strengths and weaknesses, and suggests actionable improvements through a clean, modern, and responsive interface.
features: 📄 Resume Upload — Upload your resume securely for instant analysis.
🤖 AI Resume Analysis — Get smart, role-specific feedback powered by AI.
📊 ATS Score — Receive an ATS compatibility score to improve shortlisting chances.
🔍 Section-wise Feedback — Detailed insights on skills, experience, projects, and formatting.
✨ Improvement Suggestions — Actionable recommendations to enhance resume quality.
🌓 Dark Mode — Smooth light and dark theme support for better readability.
⚡ Fast & Responsive UI — Optimized performance across all devices.
🔐 Secure Handling — User data handled securely with authentication support.

title: Music App
about: A sleek and responsive music player app to play, pause, skip songs, and manage playlists with a clean UI and smooth controls.
features: 🎵 Play, pause, skip tracks with repeat and shuffle support.
🔍 Search songs by title or artist with voice search support.
📃 Create, manage playlists and mark songs as favorites.
🌗 Light and dark mode with responsive mobile-friendly UI.
🎨 Smooth animations, toast notifications, and skeleton loading UI.
💾 Persistent data storage with seamless navigation experience.

title: E-commerce
about: A modern and fully responsive E-Commerce web application that allows users to browse products, filter by categories, search items, view details, and manage a shopping cart with real-time toast notifications. Built with scalability and performance in mind.
features: 🔍 Search and browse products by category.
🛒 Add, remove, and manage cart items with quantity control.
🌗 Light and dark mode with responsive mobile-friendly UI.
⚡ Smooth UX with toast notifications, skeleton loading, and auto navigation.
